newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU seen valuing early-Dec French wheat at $155.50.
newsitem.headline: EU seen valuing early-Dec French wheat at $155.50.

text.p: A European Union award of 256,500 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 15.97 Ecus per tonne, reported by EU grain officials, values a tonne of early-December French wheat at $155.50 per tonne, Reuters calculates.
The figure, which should be regarded as an estimate only, is based on benchmark standard-quality French milling wheat at Rouen and may vary significantly for other EU origins and types.
